name: coverage-band
description: Test coverage above the prompt after every test run, with the change since the last run and the modules below your threshold.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: hint: dim text at the end of the hint line under the prompt. band: a colored row above the prompt. status: a pinned notice under the prompt.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Minimum line coverage, in percent, for the whole run and for each module.

gaugeWidth.title: Gauge width
gaugeWidth.description: How many cells the coverage gauge has.
